design: retrospective fixed-count analysis; historical outcomes were already known; not independent preregistration
primary_center: traffic counts / 1000, identical to historical draw reconstructed from frozen seed
sensitivity_center: minimum enclosing L1/2 radius over simplex centers using traffic geometry only; rationalized center, radius recomputed exactly; LP upper gap <=1e-8
common_acceptance: original Table5 box minimum of CP lower endpoints at .04/(4*12); positive gate and tie rule unchanged for all methods
native_TV_acceptance: center-weighted same CP acceptance limits minus radius, recorded separately, not used for primary ranking
stronger_diagnostic: TV_COMPOSED_CP_BETTING_H uses min(1,2*min(TV_DIRECT_BETTING_H member p, CP_IUT_H member p)) then Holm; not a free best-of selector
risk_test: X=A*(error-alpha), D_w=sum w_j E[X_j]. TV risk condition D_w+eta<=0. Shifted fixed-stratum bets use X+eta; no iid pooling. Eight historical stakes and SCALE weights fixed. M=12 includes infeasible slots.
PASS_CONDITIONAL_TV_COMPARISON: At least one prespecified direct method exceeds EACH of four primary-center TV procedures by >=0.01 overall ECA, with positive differences in both 50-cell adaptation arms, and exact geometry slack validates. No general method superiority or external-transfer claim.
KILL_DIRECT_UTILITY_CLAIM: Every prespecified direct method has nonpositive mean difference versus the strongest primary-center TV method by aggregate mean. Preserve all results.
other_results: HOLD; validity/input/numeric failure INVALID before performance
sensitivity: Both centers, four native TV tests, composed diagnostic, every outcome and candidate flag reported; no outcome-based center/test selection for deployment. Report whether center sensitivity changes the primary conclusion.
mechanism: For all 1200 candidates decompose direct MASS-CP contrast into empirical worst contrast and endpoint inflation; TV-minus-direct into eta minus geometry contrast. Enumerate original 256 E2 states and all same-t pairs differing in exactly one of n/f_index/q_index. Preserve duplicate realized counts and label them. No new rule or performance rollout.
numeric: Reuse exact outward CP rational bounds; exact radius/slack; independently reconstruct shifted products with 60-digit arithmetic and Holm, minimum threshold margin 1e-12; assertions fail closed.
GPU_stage: Only after CPU validity and mechanistic findings are examined; independent VLCS performance protocol separately frozen before training. Existing PACS HOLD never changed.
